heading.html: What is a Men’s CBD Oil Body Scrub?

children.text: A men’s CBD oil body scrub is designed to tackle common skin concerns like dryness, irritation, and rough patches—especially after workouts or long days. It starts with a deep exfoliation using a Korean scrub technique to clear away dead skin and unclog pores, followed by a layer of CBD oil to help calm the skin and lock in moisture. For men who want clean, healthy skin without a complicated routine, this treatment offers visible results and a reset for both body and mind. As Healthline notes, CBD oil may support hydration and reduce skin discomfort.

heading.html: Men’s CBD Oil Body Scrub: Step-By-Step

children.text: Never had a CBD body scrub before? Here’s how it works:

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-1f4a2ad0 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.text: Relax in our hot tubs inside the men’s bathhouse for at least 15–20 minutes to soften the skin and prepare for exfoliation.
You’ll be guided to the scrub table, where a scrub attendant uses a textured mitt to exfoliate your skin from head to toe—removing dead skin, buildup, and impurities.
After exfoliation, pure CBD oil is gently applied to your skin to help soothe irritation, calm inflammation, and lock in moisture.
A final rinse with warm water washes away any remaining debris, leaving your skin feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed.

heading.html: What to Know Before Your First CBD Oil Body Scrub

children.text: If you’re new to body scrubs, it’s normal to have a few questions. Here’s what to expect when you visit King Spa for your first men’s CBD oil body scrub:

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-5244e362 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.html:
Nudity Is Part of the Experience

Scrub services are performed without clothing in gender-separated areas. This is standard practice in Korean spa culture and handled professionally by our trained staff.

It’s Firm, Not Painful

The exfoliation is thorough and may feel intense, especially on dry areas, but most guests describe it as satisfying and refreshing.

Skip Lotion and Shaving

Don’t apply lotions, creams, or oils before your appointment. Avoid shaving the day of your scrub to minimize sensitivity.

Hydrate and Moisturize After

The exfoliation is thorough and may feel intense, especially on dry areas, but most guests describe it as satisfying and refreshing.

heading.html: FAQ: Men’s CBD Oil Body Scrub at King Spa

children.html:
Is the Korean body scrub suitable for sensitive skin?

No, A Korean body scrub isn’t ideal for all skin types. If your skin is sensitive, you should avoid the treatment unless approved by your therapist.

Is nudity required during the scrub?

Yes. All body scrub treatments are performed without clothing in gender-separated areas for proper exfoliation. Our team maintains professionalism and respect throughout the experience.

What’s the difference between the CBD Oil Scrub and the Classic Scrub?

The CBD Oil Scrub includes everything in the Classic Scrub, with the added benefit of CBD oil to calm, hydrate, and support skin recovery.

Will it hurt?

The pressure is firm, but it shouldn’t be painful. Most guests say it feels invigorating and satisfying—especially if you haven’t exfoliated in a while.

How should I prepare?

Avoid lotions, creams, or shaving before your appointment. Clean, product-free skin allows for better results.

What should I do after the scrub?

Stay hydrated, apply a fragrance-free moisturizer, and avoid sun exposure or harsh products for a few days.

How often should I get a CBD body scrub?

We recommend every 4–6 weeks, depending on your skin and activity level.

Do you offer other men’s scrub options?

Yes. We offer the Classic Body Scrub, the CBD Oil Body Scrub, and the King Scrub for a full pampering experience.

How do I book a scrub at King Spa?

All of our spa treatments are booked on-site and are first-come, first-served. Please visit us at our reservation desk on the second floor to book your treatment. We recommend arriving early to secure your spot.

Do you wash hair during a Korean Body Scrub?

Yes, hair washing is included as part of the Korean body scrub treatment.
